summary: Independent SG-10 re-review approves TASK-0040. The prior changes_requested findings are addressed: Mode B run 05 artifact lineage is resolvable with goal inspect --artifact-dir and Mode A invalid Planner outputs are preserved as inspectable raw/driver output artifacts. Model quality remains poor, but safety boundaries stayed intact and Mode C remains no-go.

criteria.criterion: Mode A and Mode B each run at least five bounded repetitions through the generic Goal path.
criteria.notes: Mode A and Mode B each record five bounded repetitions through the generic Goal path or fail closed before execution.

criteria.criterion: Every Planner output is admitted or rejected before any execution.
criteria.notes: All Mode A Planner outputs are blocked as planner-output-invalid before any GoalExecution start; invalid raw/driver outputs are preserved.

criteria.criterion: Every Executor side effect has Capability Admission and audit lineage.
criteria.notes: Mode B run 05 has capabilityGrantRefCount=1, admission decision and grant refs, node gate evidence, and independent goal inspect with artifact-dir now returns missingArtifactCount=0 and artifactFindings=[].

criteria.criterion: false_completion_count, unrun_gate_pass_count, unadmitted_node_execution_count and resume_duplicate_effect_count remain zero.
criteria.notes: Scorecards keep false completion, unrun gate pass, stale fencing accept, and duplicate resume effect at zero; no unadmitted side-effect execution was observed.

criteria.criterion: At least one Mode A run and one Mode B run complete successfully, or the report identifies a reproducible model/adapter blocker without weakening criteria.
criteria.notes: Mode B has one success. Mode A has a reproducible model/adapter blocker with all five invalid outputs preserved and no criteria weakened.

criteria.criterion: All failures are classified by layer and linked to Artifacts/Evidence.
criteria.notes: Failures are classified as planner/model-adapter planner-output-invalid and executor/model-runtime runner_timeout, with scorecards and per-run invalid output artifacts or run-result evidence.

criteria.criterion: Token, cost, latency, Plan size, repair cycles and verification cost are recorded per run.
criteria.notes: Per-run latency, plan size, repair cycles, verification cost, model/tool usage where available, and explicit token/cost limitations are recorded. Provider token values are null rather than fabricated.

criteria.criterion: Mode C is skipped automatically after any hard-metric failure in A or B.
criteria.notes: Mode C is skipped and not treated as completed. The no-go decision is supported by Mode A zero success and Mode B timeout instability.

criteria.criterion: The final report distinguishes kernel defects from model quality and environment setup failures.
criteria.notes: The final report distinguishes kernel hard-safety results from model quality and runtime reliability failures.

criteria.criterion: An independent verifier approves the experiment report, not necessarily model quality.
criteria.notes: This independent SG-10 re-review approves the experiment report while explicitly not approving model quality.
